correctness.rationale: The product of the stationary input with the iid pair of noises is stationary, and the coordinate replacement map is equivariant. A mixing noise system preserves ergodicity on taking a product with an ergodic input; weak mixing and mixing are respectively closed under these products and factors. This is inheritance, not an assertion that a general dependent input becomes iid. Any nonempty basic open cylinder has positive probability by refreshing all of its finitely many specified sites. Conditional on X, each window constraint has probability (1−epsilon) times its input indicator plus epsilon times the admissible length, bounded by 1−epsilon+2epsilon r. Conditional independence gives the sharp power bound, attained at the all-half input and center. At radius zero this gives nonatomicity; at radius r the coordinate of weight one at each shift time gives the Bowen-ball inclusion and makes its mass zero. The stationary joining has cost epsilon times E[(X_0²+(1−X_0)²)/2], at most epsilon/2. For the all-zero input all joinings have this cost, proving sharpness even after the infimum. This coupling also has E rho at most 3epsilon/2, hence gives weak convergence as well. Given a full input block, the binned outputs have independent laws each of entropy H_epsilon(M), including bin endpoints under the stated convention. The unconditional block entropy is at least the conditional one, and the stationary entropy rate is at least H_epsilon(M)=epsilon log M+O_epsilon(1). The statements include epsilon=1, where the output is iid uniform. Exact replay of the sharp estimates uses the lengths 2r at 1/2 and integral from 0 to 1 of u du at 0; the argument establishes all block sizes, unlike the frozen finite rational checks. The bundled script was not executed.

value.rationale: The approximation keeps the dynamics and stationarity fixed and controls an invariant coupling rather than only weak convergence. At any prescribed error it supplies full support and explicit uniform anti-concentration at all window sizes, even for singular or dependent input, and identifies the entropy cost of this particular channel. The optimal constants concern natural constraints with different extremizers; the result is not merely the known existence of weakly nearby expansive probabilities.
